ops_li: Hey @support - customer reported invoice mismatch after they installed onprem metering agent 0.8.3 last week, looks like token counts double during a 20m window. Can share logs.
support_ava: Thanks — can you paste agent logs (start/stop) and whether they had offline mode enabled? :mag:
ops_li: They were on intermittent network, offline_buffering enabled, heartbeat interval 30s. Logs show repeated batches being flushed after reconnect.
eng_mark: Does the agent use durable dedupe ids? We added seq ids in 0.8.x but there was a bug when heartbeats are splayed on reconnect that replays partial batch with same seq range.
ops_li: Here's snippet from agent.log (sanitized): ```INFO flush: queued=412 seq_begin=12045 seq_end=12456 flush_id=abc123
WARN network reconnect, time_jump=+65s
INFO transmit success: ack_range=12045-12456```
support_ava: The time_jump stands out — looks like clock skew on the VM caused heartbeat splay > TTL for queued batches, agent retried and created a new flush record with overlapping seqs. That would double-count in the central ledger if dedupe didn't persist.
infra-bot: deploybot: upgrade available for metering-agent -> 0.8.5 (contains dedupe persistence fix).
eng_mark: Repro steps I used: 1) start agent w/ offline buffering. 2) enqueue 400 events. 3) suspend network, advance VM clock by +70s (sudo date -s "+70 sec"). 4) resume network. Observed duplicate delivery window when agent created new flush_id before previous ack persisted.
analytics_raj: On the billing side we see ledger entries: shadow_count shows 412 events twice around 2026-02-14T12:05 — invoice shows +$24.80 unexpected.
support_ava: Can you confirm ledger tx ids? If duplicates are present we can de-dup on billing side for that window while customers upgrade.
ops_li: We have tx ids: tx-9a8b... and tx-9a8b... (same seq ranges) — I can open a support case for invoice credit.
eng_mark: Short-term mitigation: ask customer to pin agent to 0.8.5 when released or restart agent container with monotonic time source (use CLOCK_MONOTONIC). Long-term: server side will ignore flushes with overlapping seq ranges that have an existing ack.
support_ava: I'll escalate to billing for provisional credit and schedule on-prem patch. @analytics_raj can you start a billing adjustment and label incident "onprem-heartbeat-splay-dup"? :white_check_mark:
ops_li: Thanks — I'll get customer to upgrade and confirm after patch.
infra-bot: incidentbot: created INC-3267 linking logs and ledger snapshots.
support_ava: tagging follow-ups: eng-runtime (for hotfix), billing (for credit), customer-success (for communication).
